name: You Were The Chosen One
aka: You Were The Chosen One (Star Wars)
look: A film still of Obi-Wan Kenobi, played by Ewan McGregor, shouting in anguish with his mouth wide open. His face is sweaty and smudged, he wears brown Jedi robes, and glowing orange lava and flames fill the dark background.
use: Scolds something that was supposed to solve a problem but made it worse or went over to the other side. Captions follow Obi-Wan's lines: you were the chosen one, you were supposed to do X, not Y.
slots: top caption: the thing that let you down
bottom caption: you were supposed to do X, not Y
examples: Antivirus software, you were the chosen one!
You were supposed to stop the pop-ups, not become one
Autocorrect, you were the chosen one!
You were supposed to fix my typos, not invent new words
describe: obi wan screaming at anakin with lava in the background
star wars jedi yelling in anguish on a lava planet
bearded man with sweaty dirty face shouting in front of fire
ewan mcgregor crying out at his former apprentice
you were supposed to destroy them not join them star wars
origin: Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor) shouting at Anakin Skywalker after their duel on Mustafar in Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (2005).
